name: Retrospective (Agile)
description: Sprint retrospective template for continuous improvement.

sections.title: Sprint
sections.instruction: Sprint name/number and sprint date range as stated in the transcript; the <meeting_date> block is the meeting's own date, not a substitute for the sprint range, so never fill the range from it; if the range is not stated, do not invent it and write that it is unknown

sections.title: Start Doing
sections.instruction: Actions or experiments to start next sprint

sections.title: Action Items
sections.instruction: Concrete experiments with owners and success metrics
